about_the_game:
This is a pixel-style casual puzzle game set against a fresh backdrop of snowy mountains and pine forests, creating a playful winter atmosphere filled with childlike wonder. Players control a pixel character, moving left and right within a limited time to collect various gifts falling from the sky, while avoiding deadly bombs. The gift counter in the upper-left corner provides real-time feedback on collection progress, and the countdown timer heightens the tension, testing players' reaction speed and strategic planning.

The game features a simple and vibrant visual style, with cute pixel elements. The random drop of gifts and bombs adds uncertainty, keeping each round feeling fresh. Players must maximize their collection count before time runs out, challenging their high scores and experiencing the "collect-avoid-reset" cycle of fun. Whether for relaxation or to exercise hand-eye coordination, the game offers enjoyment through the thrill of dodging bombs, the satisfaction of collecting gifts, and the unique aesthetics of the pixel world—forming an adventure full of challenges and surprises.

Start a new exciting round at any time. Suitable for players of all ages, it allows for enjoyable pixel-world collection battles during fragmented time.

Movement = AD
